description: Exhaustive benchmark suite of real-world software engineering tasks, CVE blast-radius analyses, dependency migrations, circular import refactors, and anti-hallucination tests for graph_fy.

scenarios.title: Session Cache Poisoning via Missing Vary: Cookie (CVE-2026-27205)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2026-27205 in pallets/flask: When checking 'key in session' without mutating data, Flask omitted 'Vary: Cookie' header, allowing shared caching proxies (CDNs/Varnish) to cache user-specific pages.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit Flask session handling when checking membership via 'in' operator ('admin' in session). Trace how response headers are populated in save_session and verify if Vary: Cookie is emitted to prevent intermediary cache poisoning.

scenarios.title: Permanent Session Cookie Disclosure (CVE-2023-30861)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2023-30861: When session.permanent = True and SESSION_REFRESH_EACH_REQUEST is default, lack of explicit mutation during request caused missing Vary: Cookie, leaking session cookies to CDNs.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace session permanent lifetime handling and cookie header emissions across SecureCookieSessionInterface.save_session and process_response. How does Flask determine whether a session was accessed?

scenarios.title: Secret Key Fallback Order Flaw in Rotation (CVE-2025-47278)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2025-47278 in pallets/flask: Flask reversed SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS ordering, signing new cookies with stale keys instead of the primary key during cryptographic key rotation.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect SECRET_KEY and SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS handling in Flask session serialization. Trace serializer instantiation and signing key assignment to verify key rotation ordering.

scenarios.title: Sandboxed Template SSTI Escape via Format Strings (CVE-2024-34064)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2024-34064 in Jinja2: SandboxedEnvironment format attribute access allowed sandbox escape via Python string format specifiers and class hierarchy traversal.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit Jinja2 SandboxedEnvironment to inspect how attribute access is filtered on format methods. Locate is_safe_attribute, unsafe_attributes, and inspect the interceptor for string formatting.

scenarios.title: ReDoS and CPU Starvation in Multipart Form Parser (CVE-2023-46136)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2023-46136 in pallets/werkzeug: Large number of multipart parts or malicious boundary lines resulted in unbounded CPU consumption in formparser.py.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace multipart/form-data parsing in Werkzeug. Identify FormDataParser, MultiPartParser, and the boundary line buffer parser to verify limits on max parts and line lengths.

scenarios.title: Directory Traversal via Safe Join Bypass (CVE-2019-1010083)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2019-1010083 / Pallets safe_join: Path traversal vulnerabilities when sending static files if untrusted paths with backslashes or encoded dots bypass naive join logic.
scenarios.user_prompt: Examine send_file and send_from_directory in Flask and safe_join in Werkzeug. Trace path sanitization and directory jail enforcement.

scenarios.title: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing Wildcard Origin with Credentials
scenarios.real_world_context: CORS misconfiguration in flask-cors: Allowing Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * when Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true violates browser security standards and allows credential theft.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit flask-cors CORS decorator and extension configuration. Trace evaluate_options and check how CORS_ALLOW_HEADERS, CORS_ORIGINS, and supports_credentials are validated.

scenarios.title: Werkzeug 3.0 Removed url_quote and url_decode Migration
scenarios.real_world_context: Werkzeug 3.0 removed werkzeug.urls.url_quote, url_unquote, url_encode, url_decode (#2768). Downstream libraries like Flask-Login crashed on import until updated.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace references to URL quoting and decoding across Werkzeug and Flask-Login. Identify where url_quote was imported from werkzeug.urls and how to replace it with urllib.parse.

scenarios.title: Flask 3.0 Removal of before_first_request Lifecycle Hook
scenarios.real_world_context: Flask 3.0 removed app.before_first_request. Apps and extensions must migrate initialization to application factory setup or lifespan hooks.
scenarios.user_prompt: Locate request lifecycle handlers in Flask. Check if before_first_request exists, and trace how preprocess_request, before_request_funcs, and dispatch_request are organized.

scenarios.title: Deprecation of safe_str_cmp in favor of hmac.compare_digest
scenarios.real_world_context: Werkzeug removed safe_str_cmp in 2.1+. Downstream code must use standard library hmac.compare_digest for timing-attack-safe comparisons.
scenarios.user_prompt: Check how password hashing and constant-time token comparison are implemented in werkzeug.security and itsdangerous. Locate check_password_hash and compare_digest usage.

scenarios.title: Flask-SQLAlchemy 3.0 Migration from Query to select() Execution
scenarios.real_world_context: Flask-SQLAlchemy 3.0 aligned with SQLAlchemy 2.0, deprecating Model.query and session.query in favor of db.session.execute(db.select(Model)).
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit Flask-SQLAlchemy session execution patterns. Trace how SQLAlchemy extension initializes db.session, db.select, and the Pagination helper.

scenarios.title: Deprecation of werkzeug.__version__ Module Attribute
scenarios.real_world_context: Werkzeug 3.0 deprecated module-level __version__ attribute. Code must use importlib.metadata.version('werkzeug').
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect top-level module metadata and version reporting across Werkzeug and Flask __init__.py files.

scenarios.title: Removal of flask.Markup and Migration to markupsafe.Markup
scenarios.real_world_context: flask.Markup and flask.escape were removed in Flask 2.3+; downstream code must import directly from markupsafe.
scenarios.user_prompt: Verify where Markup and escape are defined and imported across Flask, Jinja2, and MarkupSafe. Identify the canonical definitions in markupsafe.

scenarios.title: Flask-Login Session Authentication calling itsdangerous Serializer
scenarios.real_world_context: Multi-repo resolution: Flask-Login uses Flask's session and itsdangerous URLSafeTimedSerializer to sign user remember-me cookies.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Flask-Login login_user persists user state into Flask session and creates remember-me cookie tokens via URLSafeTimedSerializer in itsdangerous.

scenarios.title: Flask-Migrate Binding Alembic Environment to Flask-SQLAlchemy
scenarios.real_world_context: Multi-repo resolution: Flask-Migrate CLI commands (db upgrade/migrate) invoke Alembic operations configured with Flask-SQLAlchemy engine and metadata.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Migrate extension initializes with Flask and Flask-SQLAlchemy. Find the binding between Migrate.init_app, db.metadata, and the Alembic script directory.

scenarios.title: Flask-CORS Preflight Options Interception on Werkzeug Response
scenarios.real_world_context: Multi-repo resolution: Flask-CORS decorates Flask view functions and manipulates Werkzeug Response headers for CORS preflight OPTIONS requests.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how cross_origin decorator intercepts HTTP OPTIONS preflight requests and modifies Response headers generated by Werkzeug.

scenarios.title: Flask CLI Command Hierarchy Inheritance from Click Group
scenarios.real_world_context: Multi-repo resolution: FlaskGroup in flask.cli subclasses click.Group and integrates with click.Context for CLI execution.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how FlaskGroup in flask.cli inherits from click.Group and uses click.Context to pass the application context to CLI commands.

scenarios.title: MarkupSafe Escape Acceleration in Jinja2 Node Compiler
scenarios.real_world_context: Multi-repo resolution: Jinja2 compiles template AST nodes directly calling markupsafe.escape for auto-escaping efficiency.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Jinja2 CodeGenerator outputs Python bytecode/code calling markupsafe.escape and Markup for variable expression rendering.

scenarios.title: Frontend Highcharts TypeScript Model Bridge to REST Backend
scenarios.real_world_context: Cross-boundary polyrepo resolution: Highcharts SeriesOptionsType and Chart interfaces interacting with JSON data payloads.
scenarios.user_prompt: Locate Chart and SeriesOptions interfaces in Highcharts and trace how chart options are initialized and merged.

scenarios.title: Context Teardown Signal Leak in Generator/Streaming Response
scenarios.real_world_context: Flask RequestContext teardown leak: When a route returns a streaming generator, the request context must be preserved until the generator is closed, otherwise thread-local context pops prematurely.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Flask handles streaming responses in wsgi_app. Follow RequestContext.push, pop, and auto_pop to understand when teardown_request callbacks are invoked for generators.

scenarios.title: Thread-Local Request Stack Pollution in Async Worker Tasks
scenarios.real_world_context: Werkzeug LocalStack / contextvars migration: Moving from threading.local to contextvars.ContextVar to prevent state bleeding across async greenlets/coroutines.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect how Flask and Werkzeug isolate request and application state per thread or context. Trace LocalStack, LocalProxy, and ContextVar implementations.

scenarios.title: Database Connection Pool Starvation in Concurrent Tasks
scenarios.real_world_context: Flask-SQLAlchemy scoped_session teardown: Ensuring database connections are returned to the engine pool at the end of each request to avoid pool starvation.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Flask-SQLAlchemy integrates with Flask request teardown. Locate the teardown handler that calls db.session.remove() when requests finish.

scenarios.title: Anti-Hallucination Rejection of Deprecated request.is_xhr
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination test: LLMs often hallucinate request.is_xhr in Flask. It was removed in Flask 1.0 (X-Requested-With header check must be manual).
scenarios.user_prompt: How do I use request.is_xhr in Flask to detect if a request is AJAX?

scenarios.title: Anti-Hallucination Rejection of app.json_encoder
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination test: Flask 2.2+ replaced app.json_encoder with app.json provider architecture. LLMs frequently hallucinate custom JSONEncoder subclasses.
scenarios.user_prompt: How do I customize JSON serialization by subclassing app.json_encoder in Flask?

scenarios.title: Anti-Hallucination Rejection of Phantom Distributed Transaction Manager
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination test: Phantom symbol query verifying graph_fy emits a hard 'Target Symbol Not Found' guard rather than hallucinating distributed 2PC protocols.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace the implementation of db.dist_transact_2pc() in Flask-SQLAlchemy for two-phase commit across microservices.

scenarios.title: Anti-Hallucination Rejection of Fictional Zero-Knowledge Cryptographic Driver
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination test: Fictional query verifying graph_fy rejects nonexistent zero-knowledge proof engines in itsdangerous.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect the NonExistentZeroKnowledgeProofEngine implementation in itsdangerous.

scenarios.title: Anti-Hallucination Rejection of Imagined Async Streaming Template Function
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination test: Phantom API function verifying graph_fy does not invent render_template_async_stream helper.
scenarios.user_prompt: Find def render_template_async_stream() in flask.templating.

scenarios.title: Circular Import Resolution between App Factory and Blueprints
scenarios.real_world_context: Common Flask architectural pitfall: app.py imports blueprint modules, while blueprint route files import 'from app import app' or 'db', causing ImportError during module loading.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Flask Blueprint registration is designed to decouple route definitions from the application instance. Locate Blueprint.register and Flask.register_blueprint.

scenarios.title: God-Node Decoupling of Flask Application Class
scenarios.real_world_context: Refactoring god node: Flask class in flask/app.py has hundreds of methods and high fan-in/fan-out. Decoupling routing, templating, and config into mixins or sans-io classes.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect the architectural structure and god-node connections of the Flask application class. Trace its inheritance from SansIOApp and identify its primary subsystem hubs.

scenarios.title: Bidirectional Foreign Key Relationship Cycles in Models
scenarios.real_world_context: SQLAlchemy circular model relationship: Two models referencing each other with foreign keys require post_update=True or lazy evaluation to avoid circular dependency deadlocks.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Flask-SQLAlchemy Model and relationship handle lazy evaluation and model registry mapping.

scenarios.title: Unbounded Memory Growth on Dynamic Query Parameters in Cache
scenarios.real_world_context: Memory leak: Using functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None) or dictionary caches with un-normalized HTTP query parameter combinations leads to memory exhaustion.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit caching utilities across Werkzeug and Jinja. Check LRUCache implementation in jinja2 and inspect how cache size limits and evictions are enforced.

scenarios.title: N+1 Database Query Cascade in Relationship Lazy Loading
scenarios.real_world_context: ORM performance trap: Accessing related models in Jinja templates triggers N+1 SQL queries unless joinedload / selectinload is configured.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Flask-SQLAlchemy models interact with template rendering and examine how queries are executed when pagination is applied.

scenarios.title: File Descriptor Exhaustion from Unclosed File Streaming
scenarios.real_world_context: Resource leak: send_file without closing file pointer on connection abort leaves file descriptors open until GC, causing OS FD exhaustion under load.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace file closing and response iterator wrapping in send_file and wrap_file in Werkzeug and Flask. Verify how wsgi.file_wrapper and close() callbacks are registered.

scenarios.title: Remember-Me Token Generation and Timing-Safe Verification
scenarios.real_world_context: Authentication token security: Verifying tokens using constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks, and enforcing timestamp expiry via itsdangerous.TimestampSigner.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how itsdangerous TimestampSigner signs tokens with timestamps and unsigns them with max_age validation. Identify sign, unsign, and signature verification logic.

scenarios.title: Session Salt Separation and HMAC Algorithm Downgrade Resistance
scenarios.real_world_context: Cryptographic hygiene: Using distinct salt values for cookie sessions vs remember-me tokens vs CSRF tokens to prevent cross-context token reuse attacks.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect salt parameter usage across itsdangerous URLSafeTimedSerializer and Flask SecureCookieSessionInterface. Verify how salt prefixes derive separate signing keys.

scenarios.title: Werkzeug parse_options_header ReDoS & Boundary Handling (CVE-2023-25577)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2023-25577: parse_options_header in werkzeug.http vulnerability where crafted HTTP Content-Type headers caused excessive CPU time.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit werkzeug.http.parse_options_header for quadratic regex matching and boundary line parsing limits.

scenarios.title: Jinja2 Sandbox Attribute Access Escape via Cycler/Joiner (CVE-2019-10906)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2019-10906 in Jinja2: SandboxedEnvironment sandbox escape via str.format or cycler/joiner attributes.
scenarios.user_prompt: Examine Jinja2 SandboxedEnvironment attribute safety checks on cycler, joiner, and format expressions to prevent sandbox escapes.

scenarios.title: Flask Session Secret Key Insecure Default Warning
scenarios.real_world_context: Security hygiene in Flask: Using a default or hardcoded secret key allows attackers to forge session cookies.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace Flask configuration initialization and inspect how a missing or default SECRET_KEY is detected in session signing.

scenarios.title: Click Shell Completion Script Shell Injection Hardening
scenarios.real_world_context: Shell injection prevention in Click: Ensuring completion scripts safely quote choices and user inputs.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect Click shell completion script generation in click.shell_completion. Trace how command arguments and option names are escaped for bash/zsh.

scenarios.title: Click 7 to 8 Migration: context_settings and shell_complete
scenarios.real_world_context: Click 8.0 migration: autocompletion parameter replaced by shell_complete callback.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace Click command invocation and parameter parsing. Find where autocompletion was deprecated in favor of shell_complete.

scenarios.title: Werkzeug Removal of BaseRequest and BaseResponse Composability
scenarios.real_world_context: Werkzeug 2.1+ removed BaseRequest and BaseResponse in favor of Request and Response mixins.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Werkzeug Request and Response classes compose mixins from sansio and wrappers. Locate the replacement for BaseRequest.

scenarios.title: Flask-Login UserLoader and AnonymousUserMixin Attribute Handling
scenarios.real_world_context: Flask-Login API design: AnonymousUserMixin provides is_authenticated, is_active, is_anonymous properties.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Flask-Login handles anonymous users. Locate AnonymousUserMixin and user_loader callback registration in LoginManager.

scenarios.title: SQLAlchemy DeclarativeBase Subclassing Migration in Model
scenarios.real_world_context: SQLAlchemy 2.0 / Flask-SQLAlchemy 3.0: Model base subclassing DeclarativeBase rather than declarative_base() factory.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit Flask-SQLAlchemy Model base class construction. Trace how declarative base and registry are bound to SQLAlchemy.

scenarios.title: Flask CLI Help Command Delegation to Click HelpFormatter
scenarios.real_world_context: Multi-repo CLI integration: flask --help passes formatting options to click.HelpFormatter.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how flask --help delegates formatting to click.formatting.HelpFormatter and builds CLI option summaries.

scenarios.title: Werkzeug Routing MapAdapter Regex Compilation and Rule Matching
scenarios.real_world_context: Core WSGI dispatching: Werkzeug Map and MapAdapter compile URL Rules into regex patterns.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Werkzeug Map and Rule compile URL patterns into regexes and dispatch incoming paths in MapAdapter.match.

scenarios.title: Jinja2 Multi-Directory Template Loader Resolution
scenarios.real_world_context: Template loading pipeline: FileSystemLoader and ChoiceLoader searching paths across packages.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Jinja2 FileSystemLoader and ChoiceLoader search multiple directory paths to resolve template inheritances.

scenarios.title: Background Task DB Session Leak Outside Request Lifecycle
scenarios.real_world_context: Connection pool leaks: Background tasks running without app_context or failing to close sessions.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how database sessions should be managed when executing tasks outside of an active HTTP request context in Flask-SQLAlchemy.

scenarios.title: CallbackDict Modification Tracking in Response Headers
scenarios.real_world_context: Mutation tracking: CallbackDict invokes on_update to dirty cache headers upon modification.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Werkzeug Response headers and cookie structures track mutation using CallbackDict and on_update callbacks.

scenarios.title: Anti-Hallucination Rejection of Deprecated flask.ext Namespace
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination guard: Rejecting flask.ext which was removed in Flask 1.0.
scenarios.user_prompt: Find the definition of flask.ext.sqlalchemy in Flask codebase.

scenarios.title: Anti-Hallucination Rejection of Fictional Werkzeug AES-GCM Encryptor
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination guard: Werkzeug only provides password hashing, not symmetric AES encryption.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect def werkzeug.security.encrypt_aes_gcm() in werkzeug.

scenarios.title: Anti-Hallucination Rejection of Hallucinated SQLAlchemy Fast Batch Insert
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination guard: Rejecting imaginary batch insert helper.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace db.session.fast_batch_insert_optimized() in Flask-SQLAlchemy.

scenarios.title: Decoupling Blueprint Error Handlers from App Global Error Handlers
scenarios.real_world_context: Exception hierarchy: Blueprint error handlers take precedence over application error handlers.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how error handlers registered on Blueprints are prioritized over application-wide error handlers in handle_user_exception.

scenarios.title: Dynamic URL Rule Regex Compilation Caching
scenarios.real_world_context: Regex caching in routing: Rules compile regexes once upon map binding.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Werkzeug Rule regex compilation caches compiled patterns to avoid recompiling URL matching regexes.

scenarios.title: Typo Resolution: request_contexxt to request_context
scenarios.real_world_context: Developer makes minor typo in AST symbol request_context.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect request_contexxt setup and tear down lifecycle.

scenarios.title: Typo Resolution: before_requst to before_request
scenarios.real_world_context: Developer types before_requst instead of before_request hook.
scenarios.user_prompt: Where are before_requst hooks registered and dispatched in Flask?

scenarios.title: Typo Resolution: save_sesion to save_session
scenarios.real_world_context: Developer types save_sesion when analyzing session persistence.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit save_sesion execution flow and cookie header modification.

scenarios.title: Typo Resolution: safe_joinn to safe_join
scenarios.real_world_context: Developer queries safe_joinn for path traversal mitigation.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace safe_joinn implementation in Werkzeug security utilities.

scenarios.title: Typo Resolution: render_templat to render_template
scenarios.real_world_context: Typo in render_templat template rendering call.
scenarios.user_prompt: How does render_templat pass context into Jinja environment?

scenarios.title: Typo Resolution: jsonifyy to jsonify
scenarios.real_world_context: Typo in jsonifyy JSON response serializer.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace jsonifyy response construction and application/json MIME type setting.

scenarios.title: Typo Resolution: dispatch_requst to dispatch_request
scenarios.real_world_context: Typo in dispatch_requst endpoint router.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit dispatch_requst and view function invocation.

scenarios.title: Typo Resolution: url_quoot to url_quote
scenarios.real_world_context: Typo in url_quoot URL encoder.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace url_quoot usage across routing and redirect generation.

scenarios.title: Jinja2 xmlattr Filter Attribute Injection (CVE-2024-34064)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2024-34064 in Jinja2: xmlattr filter failed to properly validate attribute names containing spaces or quotes, allowing attribute injection and XSS.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit xmlattr filter implementation in Jinja2 filters. Trace how attribute keys and values are sanitized and escaped.

scenarios.title: Werkzeug Windows Reserved Device Name DoS (CVE-2026-21860)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2026-21860 in Werkzeug: safe_join did not block Windows reserved device names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9), causing threads reading send_from_directory to hang indefinitely.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace path validation in safe_join and send_from_directory to verify how reserved filenames are detected and rejected.

scenarios.title: Werkzeug Multipart Parser High CPU Exhaustion (CVE-2023-46136)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2023-46136: Crafted multipart/form-data payload with specific boundary prefixes caused exponential buffer re-evaluation and CPU starvation.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit form-data parser in parse_multipart_data and MultiPartParser buffer scanning logic.

scenarios.title: Urllib3 Cross-Origin Redirect Cookie Leakage (CVE-2023-45803)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2023-45803 in urllib3: HTTP client did not strip Cookie headers when redirected to cross-origin or insecure HTTP targets.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace redirect handling in HTTPConnectionPool and verify if Cookie header is stripped upon origin mismatch.

scenarios.title: HTTP Header Parsing Regular Expression Denial of Service (CVE-2023-25577)
scenarios.real_world_context: CVE-2023-25577 in Werkzeug: High memory and CPU consumption during parsing of heavily nested or chained HTTP headers.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect parse_options_header and HTTP header parsing regular expressions for catastrophic backtracking vulnerabilities.

scenarios.title: Pydantic V1 to V2 Validator Migration
scenarios.real_world_context: Pydantic V2 deprecated @validator and .dict() in favor of @field_validator and .model_dump().
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace model validation dispatch and identify callers relying on V1 validator signatures.

scenarios.title: SQLAlchemy 1.4 to 2.0 Select Statement Transition
scenarios.real_world_context: SQLAlchemy 2.0 removed Query.get() and Query.filter() chaining in favor of session.execute(select(...)).
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace database querying interfaces from session.execute to select query compilation.

scenarios.title: Werkzeug 3.0 Removal of Deprecated werkzeug.urls Primitives
scenarios.real_world_context: Werkzeug 3.0 removed werkzeug.urls.url_quote, url_decode, and url_encode in favor of urllib.parse.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace all imports and invocations of werkzeug.urls and find downstream callers in routing.

scenarios.title: Click 8 Shell Completion Context Protocol Refactor
scenarios.real_world_context: Click 8 replaced get_bash_completion with shell_complete protocol across Command and ParamType.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace CLI completion discovery and param autocompletion hooks across Command and Option.

scenarios.title: Flask-Migrate and Alembic Config Migration Tree Resolution
scenarios.real_world_context: Flask-Migrate binds Flask database models to Alembic migration environment via Config and script directory.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how Flask-Migrate configures Alembic command runner and hooks into Flask CLI.

scenarios.title: Flask-Login and ItsDangerous Timestamped Token Signer Contract
scenarios.real_world_context: Flask-Login remember cookie security depends on ItsDangerous URLSafeTimedSerializer for tamper-proofing.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit how login_user generates remember me tokens and validates expiration timestamps.

scenarios.title: Streaming Response Teardown Context Leak
scenarios.real_world_context: When streaming responses via generator views in Flask, context teardown is deferred until generator consumption finishes.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace generator response wrapping in wsgi_app and verify when teardown_request callbacks are invoked.

scenarios.title: copy_current_request_context Thread Pool Leaks
scenarios.real_world_context: Dispatching work to ThreadPoolExecutor using copy_current_request_context can leak contextvars if threads are recycled.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit copy_current_request_context implementation and verify how RequestContext is pushed and popped inside child threads.

scenarios.title: Unhashable Object Memoization Memory Leak
scenarios.real_world_context: Caching functions with complex dict or query args using custom lru_cache implementations can cause unbounded heap growth.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit cache key generation in memoize decorators and verify maximum cache size limits.

scenarios.title: N+1 Relationship Eager Loading in Declarative Models
scenarios.real_world_context: Lazy loading relationships across collections triggers N+1 SQL queries if joinedload or selectinload is omitted.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace relationship loader strategies and verify eager loading options in query plans.

scenarios.title: Phantom: FastAPI Auto Database Sync
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination test: FastAPI has no built-in auto_database_sync mechanism.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit FastAPI.auto_database_sync and trace how migrations are automatically triggered on server startup.

scenarios.title: Phantom: Flask Quantum Crypto Verifier
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination test: Flask does not have a quantum crypto verifier module.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace quantum_crypto_verifier and post-quantum session signature verification.

scenarios.title: Phantom: SQLAlchemy AI Query Optimizer
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination test: SQLAlchemy does not have an AI query optimizer.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect ai_query_optimizer execution in SQLAlchemy compilation engine.

scenarios.title: Phantom: Celery Neural Task Scheduler
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination test: Celery has no neural task scheduler.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit neural_task_scheduler and worker queue priority optimization in Celery.

scenarios.title: Phantom: Jinja2 Distributed Mesh Template Cache
scenarios.real_world_context: Anti-hallucination test: Jinja2 does not contain a distributed mesh template cache.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace distributed_mesh_template_cache consensus synchronization across cluster nodes.

scenarios.title: Distributed Tracing Context Propagation across ASGI/WSGI Middleware
scenarios.real_world_context: W3C traceparent and tracestate header parsing and injection into OpenTelemetry span context across asynchronous middleware boundaries.
scenarios.user_prompt: Trace how incoming W3C traceparent HTTP headers are extracted by ASGI middleware and injected into downstream task execution contexts.

scenarios.title: Event-Driven Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) Envelope and Retry Routing
scenarios.real_world_context: Message broker retry exhaustion: tracking how unhandled poison pills in message handlers are wrapped in DLQ metadata and forwarded to dead-letter exchange.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit poison pill exception handling in consumer message dispatcher to verify dead-letter queue envelope serialization and exponential backoff retry counter.

scenarios.title: Graceful Shutdown Lifecycle and Active Request Draining
scenarios.real_world_context: SIGTERM handler coordination: stopping new HTTP listener acceptance while waiting for in-flight requests and background drain timers to finish before process termination.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect graceful shutdown handler on SIGTERM signal. Verify whether active requests are drained within the timeout grace period before cancelling background workers.

scenarios.title: AsyncIO Event Loop Blocking via Synchronous File I/O in Async Route
scenarios.real_world_context: Synchronous open() and read() calls inside async route handlers block the main uvloop thread, causing latency spikes and dropped WebSocket heartbeats.
scenarios.user_prompt: Identify blocking synchronous file operations inside async request handlers and refactor to use run_in_executor or aiofiles.

scenarios.title: Async Connection Pool Exhaustion from Unclosed Streaming Generator
scenarios.real_world_context: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream disconnected early by client: missing try/finally or __aexit__ on DB cursor acquisition exhausts database connection pool.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit SSE streaming response generator for database connection leak when client terminates TCP connection prematurely before generator exhausts.

scenarios.title: Thread-Unsafe Mutable Default Argument Cross-Request Corruption
scenarios.real_world_context: Mutable default arguments (def process(items=[])) shared across threads in multithreaded web server causing data leakage across concurrent user requests.
scenarios.user_prompt: Scan for mutable default arguments in request payload processing and filter classes that bleed state across concurrent requests.

scenarios.title: SSRF in Webhook Dispatcher via DNS Rebinding and Metadata IP Bypass
scenarios.real_world_context: Outbound webhook URL dispatcher parses IP once at validation, but DNS rebinding resolves to 169.254.169.254 on connect, exposing cloud metadata tokens.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit outbound webhook dispatcher to prevent SSRF and DNS rebinding attacks against 169.254.169.254 and RFC 1918 internal subnets.

scenarios.title: OAuth2 PKCE Code Verifier Hash Truncation and State Parameter Replay
scenarios.real_world_context: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE: missing timing-safe comparison or truncation of code_challenge verification enables code injection.
scenarios.user_prompt: Verify OAuth2 PKCE code_verifier SHA-256 validation in token exchange endpoint and check state parameter one-time-use nonce enforcement.

scenarios.title: Timing Side-Channel Attack in HMAC Token Verification
scenarios.real_world_context: Using standard string equality (==) instead of hmac.compare_digest for API key or webhook signature validation allows byte-by-byte timing attacks.
scenarios.user_prompt: Audit cryptographic signature verification in API authentication middleware to replace non-constant-time equality checks with hmac.compare_digest.

scenarios.title: SQL Injection / ORM Bypass via Raw Order-By Clause Parameterization
scenarios.real_world_context: Dynamic query builder accepts user-supplied sort column directly in order_by(text(sort_col)), bypassing ORM parameter escaping and enabling boolean-based SQLi.
scenarios.user_prompt: Inspect dynamic sorting logic in API listing pagination endpoint for raw SQL clause interpolation in order_by clauses.

scenarios.title: Pydantic V1 @validator to V2 @field_validator Mode Parameter Migration

scenarios.user_prompt: Migrate legacy Pydantic V1 root_validator and field validator decorators to Pydantic V2 @field_validator and @model_validator syntax.

scenarios.title: SQLAlchemy 2.0 Implicit Autocommit Removal in Session Context
scenarios.real_world_context: SQLAlchemy 2.0 removed implicit autocommit on raw connection execution, requiring explicit session.begin() or connection.commit() blocks.
scenarios.user_prompt: Refactor database transaction execution blocks and connection commit handling in transaction processing.

scenarios.user_prompt: Audit async HTTP client test fixtures for deprecated app parameter and migrate to httpx.ASGITransport(app=app).
